title: CustomDisconnect
features:
trigger a real error prompt but customizable nothing much
it acually uses the same method that roblox uses for there error prompt (but no blur but it still does freeze everything until you press something)
script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui").RobloxGui
local Package = CoreGui.Modules

local ErrorPrompt = require(Package.ErrorPrompt) 

local myPrompt = ErrorPrompt.new("Default", {
    PlayAnimation = true,
    HideErrorCode = false
})

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", CoreGui)
Gui.Name = "MainUI"
Gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

myPrompt:setParent(Gui)
myPrompt:setErrorTitle("Death Sentence")

myPrompt:updateButtons({
    {
        Text = "Aura-Farm",
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        Primary = true,
        Callback = function()
            print("you tuff...")
            myPrompt:onErrorChanged("", nil) 
        end
    },
    {
        Text = "pal💔",
        LayoutOrder = 2,
        Primary = false,
        Callback = function()
            print("well fuck you")
            myPrompt:onErrorChanged("", nil) 
        end
    }
})

local ErrorCode = { Value = 6767 }
myPrompt:onErrorChanged("tung tung sahur sentenced you to death because you didn't wake up for sahur💔", ErrorCode)
